option_relations.rationale: Chronic cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CCLE) is a subtype of Cutaneous lupus erythematosus (chronic or subacute).
Cutaneous lupus erythematosus is a broader category that encompasses 'Cutaneous lupus erythematosus (chronic or subacute)'.

Periorbital Discoid Lupus Erythematosus (DLE) is a specific form of chronic cutaneous lupus erythematosus, which falls under the broader category of 'Cutaneous lupus erythematosus (chronic or subacute)'.
Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus is explicitly mentioned as a subtype within the leaf 'Cutaneous lupus erythematosus (chronic or subacute)'.
